In this part you learn to identify the elements of music character of selected pieces of 3. Is the music fast, as used in a song to enhance for music as either sad or happy slow, loud or effective communication, •. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the elements of music character of selected pieces of 3. Is the music fast, as used in a song to enhance for music as either sad or happy slow, loud or effective communication, •.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Elements of Music RESPONDING” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the elements of music character of selected pieces of 3. Is the music fast, as used in a song to enhance for music as either sad or happy slow, loud or effective communication, •. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Elements of Music RESPONDING is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Elements of Music RESPONDING to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the elements of music character of selected pieces of 3. Is the music fast, as used in a song to enhance for music as either sad or happy slow, loud or effective communication, •.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Elements of Music RESPONDING from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Elements of Music RESPONDING: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Elements of Music RESPONDING?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Elements of Music RESPONDING means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the elements of music character of selected pieces of 3. Is the music fast, as used in a song to enhance for music as either sad or happy slow, loud or effective communication, •.
